name: smwmusic-george-stone-trip-through-the-grand-canyon
title: George Stone - Trip Through The Grand Canyon
description:
One of the first midi songs, bundled in Windows 98.
Happy-go-lucky song that starts quiet and goes wilder in the end,

good for credits or intro.

As the samples take up a lot of space, I've done a light version, to get it just change the following to 0:
Code
; _______________switch to 0 for lower res___________
#define "hi_res" 1
; ________________________________________________


You can also add more delay by adding a rest to all channels.

Made on request for NopeContest

Major edit: As warned by brickblock369, I had got a channel completely wrong due to a midi misread, it is now fixed.
